title: Green synthesis of iron oxide nanoparticles using Bacillus subtilis mitigate salinity stress in rice (Oryza sativa L.) plants and enhance physiological activities
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01184H, Paper
Hetvi Naik, Salim Manoharadas, Narayanasamy Bommayasamy, Thomas John, Muthukaruppan Gobi, Sahab Ram Dewala, Natarajan Amaresan
Salinity stress significantly affects rice production worldwide. Therefore, this study investigated the potential of bacterial-mediated synthesized iron oxide nanoparticles (IONPs) to mitigate salinity stress in rice. IONPs were characterized using...
